what.text: This page follows refugees from Bhutan living in Nepal, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6365 Bhutanese refugees in Nepal, 87.7% of all refugees from Bhutan.
Nepal is the largest host of Bhutanese refugees, followed by Denmark, France and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Bhutan, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1992 to 2011.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1991 at 9504 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 112263, at the end of 2002.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Nepal.
These are year-end totals for Nepal only, reported to UNHCR.
